description: tiktok: Transcript. GET /v1/tiktok/video/transcript. Get a TikTok video's own captions (TikTok's speech recognition or the creator's), as WebVTT and timed segments. No paid transcription. No captions in the language costs 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when transcript is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Use a cached response this old or newer for 0 credits. If none is available, fetch live at the endpoint’s normal price.

language.description: Two-letter language code, such as en or es. Defaults to the video's original captions.
